column3: Close to the Hebrew; “they will wail the songs of the temple” is rendered “the songs of the temple Shall be wailing,” and “one will throw [them out] — hush!” “They shall be thrown out in silence.”
Close to the Hebrew; “those who trample on the needy” is rendered “you who swallow up the needy.”
Close to the Hebrew; “that we may open grain” is rendered “That we may trade wheat.”
Close to the Hebrew; “the refuse of grain” is rendered “the bad wheat.”
NKJV renders “it will rise like the light” as “All of it shall swell like the River,” reading the word as “the River (Nile).”
Close to the Hebrew; “all loins” is rendered “every waist.”
Close to the Hebrew; “they will stagger” is rendered “They shall wander.”
Close to the Hebrew; “the guilt of Samaria” is rendered “the sin of Samaria,” and “your gods” “your god.”
